reason: On both sampled states the shield-check icon button next to the balance has an empty accessible name (button ""): its only content is an aria-hidden svg. The Mercury Vault tooltip text appears in a separate node that nothing ties to the button, so 4.1.2 fails. It is an informational icon, not a form control or a primary action, so it stays medium.

Each account row's drag handle (td role=button, aria-roledescription=sortable) has no name on both sampled states, so 4.1.2 fails. Its aria-describedby text tells a screen-reader user exactly how to pick up and move the row, and reordering accounts is an optional layout choice, so the impact is minor. Only the row identity is missing.
